description: Drop stored versions of a document older than older_than_versions versions back from its current one -- get {version: <a dropped version>} then reads not found.

id.description: Document id to purge old versions of; use name instead if you don't have it.

name.description: Document name to purge old versions of; use id instead if you have it.

older_than_versions.description: How many versions back from the current one to keep.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.docs.purge
